Python with class and functions, verify symbol count

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"python\",\"symbols\":true}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("MY_CONST = 42\ndef helper(): pass\nclass Widget: pass\n", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.symbols());
    }
}
```
